title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Weekly Deposit Calendar and Business-Day Basis
content:
Treasury calendar: every Cartwise Shopper Payouts plan sweeps the unpaid earnings balance to the payout destination once a week. The weekly deposit day, the smallest balance that is sent, and the arrival time differ by plan as follows.

| Plan | Weekly sweep applies | Weekly deposit day | Smallest balance sent (USD) | Arrival after sending (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weekly Direct Deposit | Yes | Tuesday | 1.00 | 3 |
| Instant Cashout | Yes | Tuesday | 1.00 | 3 |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | Yes | Tuesday | 1.00 | 0 |
| Everyday Pay Card Gold | Yes | Tuesday | 1.00 | 0 |
| Everyday Pay Card Platinum | Yes | Tuesday | 1.00 | 0 |
| Everyday Pay Card Diamond | Yes | Tuesday | 1.00 | 0 |

| Setting (identical on all six plans) | Value |
|---|---|
| When batch pay reaches the payout balance | On posting |
| Calendar used for business-day counts | US federal weekdays — Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays |
| A returned deposit or cashout amount is sent again once a new destination is on file | Yes |

**Notes.**

- The weekly deposit day is the weekday on which the deposit is sent for the earnings period that ended at the previous weekly pay cutoff.
- A balance below the smallest amount sent carries over to the following week.
- An arrival figure of 0 business days on the Everyday Pay Card plans means the deposit arrives on the card the day it is sent; a figure of 3 means arrival within three business days on the US federal weekday calendar.

*Hypothetical reading.* On Weekly Direct Deposit a deposit sent on a Tuesday that is not a federal holiday, with no federal holiday in the days that follow, is due by the Friday of the same week, three business days later.
